Samir —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the signed change form. Quick checklist from our side so we can action this without impacting the Apr 22 run:

1) We need one of the following for bank verification: (a) bank letter on bank letterhead (preferred), (b) a voided check, or (c) a bank confirmation email stamped/signed by the bank. You mentioned a bank verification letter in your message — can you attach the PDF (or upload to the portal)?
2) Confirm the remit name to appear on invoices (Lexicon Group?) and whether invoices should still reference Lexicon Labs on the PO line.
3) We'll raise an internal vendor-change ticket and place the vendor on a 48-hour verification hold for first payment after the change. If all docs look good we'll mark the record for the Apr 20 effective date.

I opened PROC-2345 internally and attached the change request form for signatures. Laura (AP) — looping you in to review bank docs and confirm there are no outstanding invoice holds. Karthik — flag if procurement needs any additional vendor attestations. Monica — please note for portal admin updates.
